Recommended 1. Buy real FPV drone -> Crash in 5 seconds -> Spend $200 on repairs. 2. Buy Liftoff -> Crash 500 times in 1 hour -> Hit reset button for free. Best investment for my wallet. 10/10.
Good game. I would say that the time I spent on here directly translated to the skills required to fly in the real world.

The way tutorial is organized is absolute rubbish. You cannot select specific part of tutorial, you cannot just jump into specific sections. And on top of that in the middle of flying it freezes for next wonderful message. …
夯，非常接近真实飞行了，不过现实里的风确实影响挺大的 1、入门两三个小时才能适应飞机那种漂移不能掌控的感觉，然后就是会转弯，会过门洞，最后再钻洞，差不多三十个小时全地图能飞行（上帝模式下），除了地库不太适应，可以适当降低摄像头角度 …
这个模拟器玩着挺不错的，手感很好，玩了几分钟就熟悉操作了，但是需要打补丁才能有中文，希望以后能有官方的中文吧
